title: There are no unconditional Schauder frames of exponentials in $L^p$ spaces, $p \ne 2$
summary: We proved recently that there are no unconditional Schauder frames of exponentials in the space $L^p(Ω)$, $1 \le p 2$, we proved that the same holds provided that $Ω$ has nonempty interior, but the general case remained open. In this note we close this gap, i.e., we establish that exponentials cannot form an unconditional Schauder frame in $L^p(Ω)$, $p \ne 2$, without any additional assumptions on the set $Ω$ of finite measure other than measurability.
